installera-zsh.hint: `sudo apt update` and then `sudo apt install zsh`.

starta-zsh.text: Start `zsh`. The first time, *zsh-newuser-install* asks what you want to do – answer `2`. Then show which shell you are running with `echo $0`.
starta-zsh.hint: Type `zsh`, answer `2` and then type `echo $0`. It should say `zsh`.

globstar.text: Use zsh's `**` to list all `.txt` files in your home directory **and all subdirectories** with a single `ls`.

tillbaka.text: Leave zsh and go back to bash.
tillbaka.hint: Type `exit`. Check with `echo $0` or `ps` if you like.

installera-fish.hint: `sudo apt update` and then `sudo apt install fish`.

fish-set.text: Start `fish`. Create the variable `{{fruitVar}}` with the value `{{fruitWord}}` the fish way and print it with `echo`.
fish-set.hint: `{{fruitVar}}={{fruitWord}}` does not work in fish. Type `set {{fruitVar}} {{fruitWord}}` and then `echo ${{fruitVar}}`.

fish-for.text: Write a `for` loop in fish syntax that prints the numbers 1, 2 and 3, one per line. Then go back to bash with `exit`.
fish-for.hint: fish has no `do` and `done` – the block ends with `end`: `for i in 1 2 3; echo $i; end`

chsh.text: Look in `/etc/shells` to see which shells are installed. Then make zsh your login shell with `chsh`.
chsh.hint: `cat /etc/shells` and then `chsh -s /usr/bin/zsh`. Check the result with `grep {{user}} /etc/passwd`.
